recommendation: Refine existing beta-lapachone entry to controlled preclinical muscle/motor functional reserve plus exposure-dependent NAD redox counterevidence; stable decision ID and no extra compound count

source.title: Beta-Lapachone, a Modulator of NAD Metabolism, Prevents Health Declines in Aged Mice

diet.population: Male mice, C57BL/6 in Methods and C57BL/6J in Results; started intervention age13months
diet.received_dose: Authors estimate70–80mg/kg/day from food intake and bodyweight, not measured systemic/muscle exposure
diet.controls: Normal chow ad libitum and70%-of-normal calorie restriction
diet.identity_limit: Supplier/catalog/purity/formulation/batch unreported; not alpha-lapachone, bark/tea or derivatives

interventions.acute: Separate5mg/kg intravenous beta-lapachone versus vehicle; n5/group muscle NAD ratio/AMPKphosphorylation; acute sampling time/vehicle formulation unspecified; body temperature separate n4/group/timecourse
interventions.genetic: No drug-by-NQO1 knockout or overexpression experiment in this primary; those mechanistic background findings belong to cited studies

functional_outcomes.interpretation: Controlled actual-compound motor positive at both visits; no quantified treatment-by-time result

functional_outcomes.procedure: Highest of5consecutive pulls; nativeaxis Max.grip strength(N)/body weight(g)
functional_outcomes.interpretation: Positive normalized strength at10months, not3months; absolute force not established, groupmean ratios cannot reconstruct individual absolute forces

functional_outcomes.procedure: Successes outof5 on vertical pole; slide or hang2minutes constitutes failure
functional_outcomes.interpretation: Controlled motor positive at10months, not3months; not a hanging-endurance assay
Positive total conditioned freezing comparison; cognitive/motor behaviour can involve brain as well as muscle

functional_denominators: Figure4 reports n10–15/group and mean±SEM; no exact arm-by-visit Ns, effect estimates or confidence intervals; no graph digitization
durability: Observations during continued feeding at3and10months, no withdrawal follow-up; significance emerging at10months is not a demonstrated change in treatment effect

bodymass_and_food.body_weight: Early decline with beta-lapachone; control survivors later lose substantial weight; longitudinal plots explicitly all survivors
bodymass_and_food.fat: Peritoneal and gonadal fat mass / tibia length reduced
bodymass_and_food.inference_limit: Bodyweight affects normalized strength and motor performance; weight/fat reduction is not growth-support evidence

molecular.NAD_pool_limit: Figure1A reports ratio only, no individual pool values. Chronic-fed tissue NAD+ increase explicitly not measured. Discussion NAD increase/turnover explanations remain unproved for dietary functional benefits.
molecular.mitochondria: NativeFigure5B higher inter-myofibrillar number /100µm² after10months, beta-v-controlP=.006, n5mice/group,7images/mouse. Representative morphology preserved; nested images are not independent mice.
molecular.transcripts: NativeFigure5C betaUCP1/UCP3 positive; betaSIRT1/SIRT3/PGC1alpha/NRF1/mTFA not positively significance-marked. These are mRNA, not protein/activity.
molecular.source_issue: Published mTFA forward/reverse primer strings identical; actual experimental primer identity not verified.
not_established: Causal mediation of motor benefit by NAD ratio/turnover

survival_and_harms.scope: Same behavioural/physiological cohort; nativeS1 substantial mortality, no initialN/numbers-at-risk/censor definitions or complete flow. Authors note shortened control lifespan and possible handling stress and require standard lifespan confirmation.
survival_and_harms.survivorship: Differential survival can change late assay composition; not an initial-cohort functional estimate without complete accounting.
survival_and_harms.safety: No systematic adverse-event or dedicated toxicity assessment. Selected plasma chemistry n5–10/group does not establish safety equivalence.
survival_and_harms.table1_precision: Cholesterol/leptin beta-v-control marked positive; glucose unmarked despite significant wording in Results; do not claim established glucose significance. Other unmarked values are not equivalence.

analysis_quality.reported_tests: t/pairedt or repeated-measures one-/two-wayANOVA, Holm–Sidak posthoc; survivalKaplan–Meier/logrank; mean±SEM
not_established: General blinded motor testing; explicit masking only for fear scoring
Exact arm/timepoint flow and missingness handling
analysis_quality.funding_conflicts: Public Korean grants, no stated funder role; three employees of Mazence declared; no further patents/products stated

2018_counterevidence.scope: Reuse earlier bounded primary/native review, not a new whole-primary read
2018_counterevidence.interpretation: Different exposure/model; does not negate2012functionalpositive. Neither study defines all-dose response or human regimen. Neither ratio nor staining alone proves NAD supply/BUBR1restoration.

competitive_judgment: Actual controlled aged-mouse function justifies positive preclinical reserve rather than counter-probe-only disposition. Compare fairly with niacin unproved restoration/human engagement and other functional leads; no comparative MVA efficacy or automatic nomination change.
unqualified_pointers: WK0202 and PMCID12364990 not imported or credited
